observations: Photo 0: A hand holds a transmission case with the oil pan removed, exposing a valve body with multiple solenoids, bolts, and a wiring harness/connector.
Photo 1: Close-up of the same exposed valve body, showing brownish/burnt-looking fluid residue on the metal surfaces and gasket area.
Photo 2: Wider view showing the valve body still mounted inside the transmission case/housing, with a separate oil pan, a flexplate/flywheel, and oil containers in the background.
No part number, Hyundai logo, or VIN tag is legible in any photo.
No photo shows a multimeter test, bench test, or any confirmation that solenoids or the valve body function electrically or hydraulically.
Setting appears to be a workshop or scrapyard, with used fluid stains and tools visible, consistent with a pulled used part.

identity.kind: automatic transmission valve body (attached inside gearbox case)

claims.evidence: Photos show the valve body still integrated inside the transmission case (photo 2), not clearly separated as a standalone 'complete' unit; no confirmation all internal components (solenoids, plates, sensors) are present and complete.
No part number, casting mark, or Hyundai-specific tag is visible in any photo to confirm make/model/year fitment.

risks.proof: A bench test video or multimeter continuity check on solenoids, or a clip of it running in a test rig.

risks.risk: Fitment to Hyundai Accent 2014 specifically is unconfirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped part number or casting code on the valve body or case.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used valve body, not confirmed fitment

risks.risk: Burnt/discolored fluid residue suggests possible overheating or internal wear history.
risks.proof: Photo of fresh, clean fluid inside the unit or service/maintenance history.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown wear/damage history

risks.risk: Wiring harness/connector pins may be corroded or damaged, affecting electronic shifting.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the connector pins and harness continuity test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unverified wiring condition

risks.proof: Seller clarification plus a photo of the exact items included, separated and laid out.
risks.if_unproven: priced as valve body only, worst case

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any stamped part number or casting code on the valve body/transmission case.
Clarify exactly what is included in the sale (valve body alone vs. full transmission).
Video of the valve body/solenoids being bench-tested or the transmission running.
Close-up of the wiring harness connector pins for corrosion/damage.
Photo of fluid drained from the unit to assess color/contamination.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used automatic transmission valve body still attached to its case, but fitment to the specific claimed vehicle and functional condition are unverifiable from photos, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, unconfirmed-fitment used part.
